description: A pipeline `configure` entry cannot weaken a governance gate (PROTOCOL_SPEC 5.16.1, decision D-130). On the built-in gate steps `acl_check` and `approval_gate`, `ignore_errors` turns a denial into a warning and lets the call run, `match_modules` exempts every module it does not match, and `pure: true` makes validate() run the approval gate -- and consult the ApprovalHandler -- during a dry run. Each MUST be rejected with PIPELINE_CONFIGURATION_ERROR (`pure: true` only on approval_gate: acl_check is pure by default because validate() runs it) while the configuration is turned into a strategy; only `timeout_ms` is configurable on a gate step. Removing a gate step (`remove:`) stays allowed with the existing warning (5.16 requirement 7). Non-gate steps are unaffected.

driver_contract.path: Build the strategy from `input.yaml` through the SDK's public config path (the same path pipeline_failfast_config.json uses). Assert `expected.raises` at that point, without executing any call.
driver_contract.assert_the_wire_code: Assert `expected.error_code`; the class name is not the contract.
driver_contract.message: When `expected.error_message_contains` is present, every listed substring MUST appear in the error message.

test_cases.note: Writing the default value explicitly weakens nothing and is accepted.
